== Description ==
'''LAPSE-2''' is one of the many Entities that is exclusive to the [[Alpha & Shadowpocalypse]] Modifier, it is the Lapse variant of [[SHA-2]].

== Behavior ==
It behaves almost exactly like [[SHA-2]], with a few differences. LAPSE-2 breaks down the door, and is effectively silent; only being able to be heard when you're really close to or in the same room as him. However, his screenshake is much more prominent so you have a way to detect him still. LAPSE-2 also has the chance to spawn himself upon despawning initially, creating a sort of "chain" of LAPSE-2s.

== Strategies & Tips ==

* Hide immediately when you see screenshake, as Lapse plague is much worse to have than Shadow plague.
* Stick to a locker when LAPSE-2 despawns to check and make sure he doesn't chain.
